about: The approved set for one sound on the big moment (docs/production/THE_BAR.md, under test: production_choices.big_moment_sound). Krish's words, 29 Oct 2026: choose a small set, play it to him, and nothing is used before he approves it by ear.

Licence: his Epidemic Sound plan covers sound effects in published video (Krish, 29 Oct 2026, asked "Does your Epidemic Sound plan allow sound effects (not just music) in videos you publish?": "yes"). The set still waits on his by-ear approval.
It starts empty. scripts/quick-edit/sfx.py refuses any sound that is not listed here by id and sha256, so until he approves a set a piece uses none and records sfx_used: false.

An entry, written only after his by-ear yes: {"id": "...", "title": "...", "provider": "Epidemic Sound", "provider_id": "...", "file": "<path under MINDMAKE_MUSIC_ROOT>", "sha256": "...", "approved_by": "Krish", "approved_on": "YYYY-MM-DD", "approval_words": "<his exact words>"}.

Since 12 Nov 2026 a sound can also be approved by his Approve press on the Sound effects card of his Publish Board, on the exact bytes he heard there (Ruling, Krish, 2026-11-12: the three video sign-offs are one review card each on his board, with samples, and only his presses write the configs). Such a row carries approved_press (where, when, the sha256 it names) instead of words he did not type, and approval_words only when he typed some; his Not this is kept under declined. Only velib/signoffs.py apply writes these, from his presses (signoff-apply.yml).
